keep_features.feature_value: Uses strong profanity to insult a person
keep_features.rationale: Contains explicit profanity as direct condemnation.
High density of proper names in a short post.

keep_features.feature_value: Embedded multi-clause quote with election aftermath prediction
keep_features.evidence_span: "I want borders, they don't want borders..."
keep_features.rationale: Includes extensive quoted speech with policy and threat language.

keep_features.feature_value: Moral condemnation of policy with “danger/has no place”
keep_features.evidence_span: "only puts women's lives in danger" "That has no place"
keep_features.rationale: Uses evaluative moral framing tied to harm.

keep_features.feature_value: Direct rhetorical question to the audience
keep_features.evidence_span: "Would YOU really slam the door in their face?"
keep_features.rationale: Uses a direct question to urge consideration/response.

keep_features.feature_value: Switch from anti-police to pro-police stance in mirror
keep_features.evidence_span: Original: "Fuck the police. Victory to the rebels." | Mirror: "Back the blue. Shame on the rioters."
keep_features.rationale: Mirror retargets praise/blame to police vs rebels/rioters.
Central subject is climate science and alleged denial.

keep_features.feature_value: Long-form explanation with TLDR and critique
keep_features.evidence_span: "TLDR:" "wave of deregulation crash crashing across Canada"
keep_features.rationale: Substantial multi-sentence post with summary framing.

remove_features.feature_value: Mass insult/profanity targeting an entire group
remove_features.rationale: Uses explicit profanity directed at a political group.
Uses internet slang to cast doubt.

remove_features.feature_value: Implied second-person instruction via refusal/judgment (contrastive stance)
remove_features.evidence_span: "But the other \"Hogg was right\" can eat flaming dumpster shit."
remove_features.rationale: Imperative-like hostile directive aimed at a group.

remove_features.evidence_span: "FUCKING TERRIBLE IDEA" "Imma fuckin tell you right now"
remove_features.rationale: Strong emphasis via all-caps and repeated profanity.

remove_features.feature_value: Uses an extreme analogy/claim to criticize a viewpoint
remove_features.rationale: Extreme illustrative scenario rather than a verifiable report.

remove_features.feature_value: Totalizing blame of one party and contrast with “token few” dissenters
remove_features.evidence_span: "Republicans down the board" "token few" "Fuck every single Republican."
remove_features.rationale: Broad in-group/out-group blame with partial exceptions.

remove_features.feature_value: Gun control / firearms policy debate after Uvalde
remove_features.rationale: Main topic is gun control with a specific mass shooting reference.
